Definition: to slacken or be feeble; figuratively, to be oppressed
BiblicalUsage: 1) to hang, languish, hang down, be low; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to hang low; 1a2) to be low; 1a3) of distress (fig.); 1a4) to languish, look weakly (of eyes); 1b) (Niphal) to be brought low, be laid low
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
